Sa couronne de feu reflète son
tempérament fougueux. Il pratique un art
martial qui fait appel à ses quatre membres
pour vaincre tout ennemi.

msgid:
A poor walker, it often falls down. However,
its strong pride makes it puff up its chest
without a care. It's difficult to bond with
since it won't listen to its Trainer.
msgstr: Il marche mal et tombe souvent, mais il\nbombe fièrement le torse. Difficile de s’en\nfaire un ami: il n’écoute pas son Dresseur.

msgid:
Because every Prinplup considers itself
to be the most important, they can never
form a group. It searches for prey in
icy seas.
msgstr:
Chaque Prinplouf se croit le plus
important, si bien qu’ils ne forment jamais
de groupe. Il chasse ses proies dans les
mers glacées.

msgid:
The three horns that extend from its
beak attest to its power. It avoids
unnecessary disputes, but it will decimate
anything that threatens its pride.
msgstr:
Les trois cornes de son bec attestent de
sa puissance. Il évite les conflits
inutiles, mais anéantit quiconque menace
sa fierté.

msgid:
They flock around mountains and fields,
chasing after bug Pokémon. However,
they bicker if the group grows too big.
Their singing is noisy and annoying.
msgstr:
Ils volent en bande dans les montagnes et
les champs pour chasser les Pokémon
Insecte. Trop nombreux, ils se chamaillent
bruyamment.

msgid:
Recognizing their own weakness, they
maintain huge flocks. Fierce scuffles
break out between various flocks.
When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.
msgstr:
Conscients de leur faiblesse, ils vivent en
grandes volées qui se querellent
violemment. Seul, un Etourvol piaille
bruyamment.

msgid:
When Staravia evolve into Staraptor,
they leave the flock to live alone. It has
a savage nature. It will courageously
challenge foes that are much larger.
msgstr:
En évoluant, les Etourvol quittent leur
volée pour vivre seuls. D’un naturel féroce,
il défie sans peur des ennemis bien plus
grands.

msgid:
A comparison revealed that Bidoof's front
teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata's.
It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to
whittle down its front teeth.
msgstr: Ses incisives poussent aussi vite que\ncelles des Rattata. Il ronge sans arrêt\nbois et pierres pour les user.

msgid:
It makes its nest by damming streams
with bark and mud. A river dammed by
Bibarel will never overflow its banks,
which is appreciated by people nearby.
msgstr:
Il construit des barrages de bois et de
boue. Une rivière endiguée par Castorno ne
déborde jamais, au grand bonheur des
riverains.

msgid:
It shakes its head back to front,
causing its antennae to hit each other
and sound like a xylophone.
These sounds are fall hallmarks.
msgstr:
Il secoue la tête d’avant en arrière pour
entrechoquer ses antennes, qui sonnent
comme un xylophone. Ce son annonce
l’automne.

msgid:
It signals its emotions with its melodies.
There is a village that hosts a contest
based on the amazingly variable cries
of this Pokémon.
msgstr: Il exprime ses émotions par ses mélodies.\nUn village organise un concours basé sur\nles cris étonnamment variés de ce Pokémon.

msgid:
It rapidly contracts and relaxes its
muscles to generate electricity. Its
body shines if endangered. It flees
while the foe is momentarily blinded.
msgstr: Il contracte ses muscles pour produire de\nl’électricité. En danger, son corps brille. Il\nfuit pendant que l’ennemi est aveuglé.

msgid:
Strong electricity courses through the
tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch
has enough amperage to cause fainting
in foes.
msgstr: Un fort courant électrique parcourt le\nbout de ses griffes acérées. Une simple\négratignure suffit à assommer l’ennemi.

msgid:
It has eyes which can see through
anything. Luxray's ability to see
through objects comes in handy when
it's scouting for danger.
msgstr: Ses yeux peuvent voir à travers n’importe\nquoi. Ce don permet à Luxray de repérer le\nmoindre danger.

msgid:
A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million
years ago, its skull is as hard as iron. 
It would snap obstructing trees with
headbutts.
msgstr:
Il vivait dans la jungle il y a 100 millions
d’années. Son crâne est dur comme le fer. Il
abattait les arbres gênants à coups de
tête.

msgid:
The result of repeated headbutts
is a skull grown thick and hard.
However, its brain has shrunk in size
compared with Cranidos's.
msgstr:
A force d’enchaîner les coups de tête, sa
calotte crânienne s’est épaissie. Son
cerveau a donc dû rétrécir et il est plus
petit que celui du Kranidos.

msgid:
This Pokémon lived in primeval jungles.
Few enemies would have been willing to
square off against its heavily armored
face, so it's thought.
msgstr:
Grâce à sa tête très robuste, on suppose
qu’il n’avait que très peu d’ennemis. Il
vivait dans les forêts primaires, il y a fort
longtemps.

msgid:
Their rock-hard faces serve to protect
them from any frontral attacks.
When attacked, they form a wall.
They shielded their young in that way.
msgstr:
Leur face dure comme la roche les protège
des attaques frontales. Attaqués, ils
forment un mur. Ainsi protégeaient-ils
leurs petits.

msgid:
If its cloak is even slightly damaged, it
will immediately repair it with whatever is
near at hand. The Pokémon within the cloak
is scrawny and vulnerable to the cold.
msgstr:
Si sa cape est abîmée, il la répare aussitôt
avec ce qui lui tombe sous la main. Le
Pokémon qu’elle abrite est chétif et
frileux.

msgid:
It weaves a cloak together with sand, mud,
and silk it spits out. This earthen cloak
is ruined by wind and rain, so the Pokémon
hides away in caves and other such places.
msgstr:
Il tisse sa cape avec du sable, de la
boue et la soie qu’il crache. Vent
et pluie l’abîment, donc il se cache
dans les grottes et autres abris.

msgid:
When confronted by a lack of other
materials, Burmy will create its cloak
using dust and refuse. The cloak seems to
be more comfortable than one would think.
msgstr:
A défaut d’autres matériaux, Cheniti
se fait une cape de poussière et de
déchets. Elle serait plus confortable
qu’on ne le pense.

msgid:
Its appearance changes depending
on where Burmy evolved. The materials
on hand become a part of its body.
The cloak is never shed.
msgstr:
Son apparence dépend de l’endroit où
Cheniti a évolué. Les matériaux alentour
font partie de son corps. Il ne quitte
jamais sa cape.

msgid:
Its earthen skin is reasonably hard, it has
no problem repelling a Starly's pecking.
It is said that a Wormadam that evolves
on a cold day will have a thicker cloak.
msgstr:
Sa peau de terre repousse sans mal
les coups de bec d’Etourmi. Evolué
par temps froid, Cheniselle aurait
une cape plus épaisse.

msgid:
Its body, composed of refuse, blends in to
the scenery enough to be inconspicuous.
This seems to be the perfect way for it to
evade the detection of predators.
msgstr:
Son corps fait de déchets se fond
dans le décor au point de passer
inaperçu. Idéal pour échapper
aux prédateurs.

source: patch FR actuel (correspondance douteuse, à vérifier)

msgid:
A Pokémon formed by three others.
It constantly gathers honey from flowers
to please Vespiquen. At night, they
cluster to form a beehive and sleep.
msgstr:
Un Pokémon formé de trois individus. Il
butine sans cesse pour plaire à Apireine.
La nuit, ils s’agglutinent en ruche pour
dormir.

msgid:
It houses its colony in cells in its body
and releases various pheromones to
make those grubs do its bidding.
There is only one in a colony.
msgstr: Son corps abrite les alvéoles de sa colonie.\nIl émet des phéromones pour commander\nses larves. Il n’y en a qu’un par colonie.

msgid:
A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek
pouches together in an effort to share
stored electricity. It stores them with
berries in tree holes.
msgstr:
On voit parfois deux Pachirisu frotter
leurs joues pour partager leur électricité.
Il en cache des boules avec ses Baies dans
des troncs creux.

msgid:
It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its
face above water in order to watch for
prey movement. It swims by rotating its
two tails like a screw.
msgstr:
Il gonfle son flotteur pour garder la tête
hors de l’eau et guetter ses proies. Il nage
en faisant tourner ses deux queues comme
une hélice.

msgid:
Its flotation sac developed as a result
of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double
as a rubber raft. It assists in the rescues
of drowning people.
msgstr:
Son flotteur s’est développé à force de
chasser des proies aquatiques. Il sert de
canot pneumatique pour secourir les gens
qui se noient.

msgid:
The small ball holds the nutrients needed
for evolution. Apparently, it is also very
sweet and tasty. Pokémon like Starly and
Taillow try to peck it off.
msgstr:
La petite boule contient les nutriments
nécessaires à son évolution. Douce et
savoureuse, elle attire les becs des
Etourmi et des Nirondelle.

msgid:
It's motionless, save for the occasional
quiver. A rich array of Pokémon can be
found gathered around it, drawn by the
scent exuded from Cherrim's folded petals.
msgstr:
Il reste immobile, parfois frémissant. De
nombreux Pokémon se rassemblent autour de
lui, attirés par le parfum de ses pétales
repliés.

msgid:
Cherrim takes this form on sunny days.
Its faint scent entices bug Pokémon to it.
It immediately closes its petals and
becomes immobile once the sun hides.
msgstr:
Ceriflor prend cette forme au soleil.
Son doux parfum attire les Pokémon
Insecte. Il se referme et se fige
dès que le soleil se cache.

msgid:
It oozes a purple fluid to deter enemies.
While harmless, the fluid is awfully sticky.
Apparently, there are more West Sea
Shellos now than there were in the past.
msgstr:
Il sécrète un liquide violet inoffensif
mais très collant pour repousser l’ennemi.
Les Sancoki Mer Occident seraient plus
nombreux qu’avant.

msgid:
It's capable of spending a limited amount
of time on land until their skin dries out.
One theory suggests that living in cold
seas causes Shellos to take on this form.
msgstr:
Il peut rester un temps sur terre,
jusqu’à ce que sa peau sèche. Vivre
dans des mers froides donnerait
cette forme à Sancoki.

msgid:
It appears on shallow-water beaches to
eat sand for nourishment. Should one
Gastrodon encounter another of a
different color, a fierce battle will ensue.
msgstr:
Il vit sur les plages et se nourrit de sable.
Quand deux Tritosor de couleurs
différentes se croisent, le combat est
féroce.

msgid:
Found more often on land than in the sea.
They normally live in rocky seashores, but
when cloudy or rainy, they can sometimes
be found on mountains, far from the sea.
msgstr:
On le trouve plus sur terre qu’en
mer. Il vit sur les côtes rocheuses,
mais par temps pluvieux, on le voit
parfois en montagne.

msgid:
Because of the way it floats aimlessly,
an old folktale calls it a “Signpost for
Wandering Spirits.” Children holding
them sometimes vanish.
msgstr:
Comme il flotte sans but, un vieux conte
l’appelle “le Guide des âmes errantes”. Les
enfants qui en tiennent un disparaissent
parfois.

msgid:
Even while under careful observation,
large flocks of Drifblim flying at dusk
will inexplicably disappear from view.
No one knows where they go.
msgstr: Même observés de près, les vols de Grodrive\nau crépuscule disparaissent\nmystérieusement. Nul ne sait où ils vont.

msgid:
You can tell how it feels by the way
it rolls its ears. When it's scared,
both ears are rolled up. When it senses
danger, it perks them up.
msgstr: La position de ses oreilles trahit son\nhumeur. Effrayé, il les enroule. S’il sent un\ndanger, il les dresse.

msgid:
An extremely cautious Pokémon.
It is very conscious of its looks and
never fails to groom its ears.
It runs with sprightly jumps.
msgstr:
Un Pokémon extrêmement prudent. Soucieux
de son apparence, il ne manque jamais de
lisser ses oreilles. Il court par bonds
légers.

msgid:
It is a very fickle Pokémon, which is 
very popular among some. It claws its
Trainer's nose if it isn't fed and
purrs when affectionate.
msgstr:
Un Pokémon capricieux, mais très apprécié
de certains. Il griffe le nez de son
Dresseur s’il a faim, et ronronne quand il
est content.

msgid:
It is a brazen brute that barges its way
into another Pokémon's nest and claims
it as its own. It binds its body with its
tails to make itself look bigger.
msgstr:
Une brute effrontée qui s’installe sans
gêne dans le nid d’autres Pokémon. Il se
ceinture de ses queues pour paraître plus
gros.

msgid:
It protects itself by spraying a
nose-curling, stinky fluid from its rear
to repel attackers. The stench lingers
for 24 hours.
msgstr: Pour se défendre, il projette par l’arrière\nun liquide puant qui fait fuir ses ennemis.\nL’odeur persiste pendant 24 heures.

msgid:
It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly
fluid from the tip of its tail. The fluid
smells worse the longer it is allowed
to fester.
msgstr: Il attaque en projetant un liquide\nnauséabond par le bout de sa queue. Plus ce\nliquide macère, plus il empeste.

msgid:
Implements shaped like it were discovered
in ancient tombs. There are researchers
who believe this Pokémon reflected like a
mirror in the distant past.
msgstr:
Des objets à son effigie ont été trouvés
dans d’anciens tombeaux. Certains
chercheurs pensent qu’il servait jadis de
miroir.

msgid:
In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as
a bringer of rain. One caused a news stir
when it was dug up at a construction site
after a 2000-year sleep.
msgstr: Jadis vénéré comme un porteur de pluie.\nL’un d’eux fit sensation en étant déterré\nsur un chantier après 2000 ans de sommeil.

msgid:
It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to
trick them into thinking it's one of them.
This way they won't attack it. It can
also learn and speak human words.
msgstr: Il imite les cris d’autres Pokémon pour se\nfaire passer pour l’un d’eux et éviter leurs\nattaques. Il peut aussi apprendre à parler.

msgid:
A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits.
Its constant mischief and misdeeds
resulted in it being bound to an
Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.
msgstr: Un Pokémon formé de 108 esprits. Ses\nméfaits incessants lui ont valu d’être lié à\nune Clé de Voûte par un sort mystérieux.

msgid:
Shiny objects are its passion. It can be
found in its cave, scarcely moving,
its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed
or Carbink it has caught.
msgstr: Il adore tout ce qui brille. Au fond de sa\ntanière, il contemple les joyaux qu’il a\ndérobés et les Strassie qu’il a kidnappés.

msgid:
When it folds up its body and extends its
wings, it looks like a jet plane. It is
covered in fine scales that reduce drag,
enabling it to fly at high speeds.
msgstr:
Quand il replie son corps et déploie ses
ailes, il ressemble à un avion à réaction.
Ses fines écailles lui permettent de voler
très vite.

msgid:
It can discern the physical and emotional
states of people, Pokémon, and other
natural things from the shape of their
aura waves.
msgstr: Il perçoit sous forme d’ondes les émotions\ndes humains et des Pokémon, ainsi que tout\nce qui l’entoure.

msgid:
It understands human speech.
It is said that no foe can remain invisible
to Lucario, since it can detect Auras.
Even foes it could not otherwise see.
msgstr: Il comprend le langage humain. Lucario\nperçoit les auras, si bien qu’aucun ennemi\nne peut se cacher de lui, même invisible.

msgid:
Hippopotas shuts its nostrils tight when
travelling through sand. Instead of
perspiration, it expels grains of sand
from its body.
msgstr: Hippopotas ferme bien ses narines quand il\nse déplace dans le sable. Au lieu de\ntranspirer, il rejette des grains de sable.

msgid:
It is surprisingly quick to anger.
It brandishes its gaping mouth in a
display of fearsome strength and raises
vast quantities of sand while attacking.
msgstr:
Il se met vite en colère. Il ouvre grand sa
gueule pour montrer sa force et soulève
d’énormes quantités de sable pour
attaquer.

source: relu et corrigé à la main (le patch FR actuel donnait un morceau

msgid:
It grips prey with its tail claws and
injects poison. It tenaciously hangs
on until the poison takes.
It can survive a year without food.
msgstr: Il agrippe sa proie avec les pinces de sa\nqueue et lui injecte du poison sans lâcher\nprise. Il peut jeûner pendant un an.

msgid:
Possessing a sturdy build, it takes
pride in its strength. It has the power
in its clawed arms to make scrap
out of a car.
msgstr: Doté d’un corps robuste, il est fier de sa\nforce. Ses bras griffus peuvent réduire\nune voiture en tas de ferraille.

msgid:
Croagunk rarely fights fairly. Inflating
its poison sacs, it fills the area with
an odd sound and hits flinching
opponents with a poison jab.
msgstr:
Cradopaud se bat rarement à la loyale. Il
gonfle ses poches à venin, émet un son
étrange et frappe l’ennemi apeuré d’un
Direct Toxik.

msgid:
Hanging from branches using its
tentacles, it looks like a plant.
It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling
saliva, then chomps down.
msgstr:
Suspendu aux branches par ses tentacules,
il ressemble à une plante. Il attire ses
proies avec sa salive parfumée, puis les
croque.

msgid:
Its double tail fins propel its energetic
jumps. When it breaks the surface of the
sea, Wingull swoop down to grab it on
the fly.
msgstr:
Avec sa double nageoire caudale, il peut
bondir hors de l’eau. C’est souvent à ce
moment que les Goélise de passage
l’attrapent et le gobent.

msgid:
Lumineon swimming in the darkness
of the deep sea look like stars shining
in the night sky. It competes for food
with Lanturn.
msgstr: Dans les abysses, les Luminéon brillent\ncomme des étoiles dans un ciel nocturne. Il\ndispute sa nourriture aux Lanturn.

msgid:
During cold seasons, it migrates to the
mountain's lower reaches. Seemingly
curious about people, they gather around
footsteps they find on snowy mountains.
msgstr: En hiver, il descend au pied des montagnes.\nCurieux des humains, il se rassemble autour\ndes empreintes laissées dans la neige.

msgid:
It lives a quiet life on mountains that
are perpetually covered in snow. It hides
itself by whipping up blizzards.
It is also known as “The Ice Monster.”
msgstr:
Il vit paisiblement dans les montagnes aux
neiges éternelles et se cache en soulevant
des blizzards. On le surnomme “le Monstre
des Glaces”.

msgid:
Its body is composed of plasma and loves
to surprise others. One boy's invention led
to the development of many machines that
can use of Rotom's unique capabilities.
msgstr:
Son corps est fait de plasma et il adore
surprendre. L’invention d’un garçon a
permis de créer des machines tirant parti
de ses pouvoirs.

msgid:
If the convection microwave oven is
not working properly, then the Rotom
inhabiting it will become lethargic. It
makes mischief by turning up the heat.
msgstr:
Si le four à micro-ondes marche
mal, le Motisma qui l’habite devient
léthargique. Il fait des bêtises
en montant le chauffage.

msgid:
It enjoys coming up with water-based
pranks. The model of washing machine that
Rotom can inspirit has been discontinued,
so they are now traded at high prices.
msgstr:
Il adore les farces aquatiques. Le
lave-linge qu’il peut posséder n’est
plus fabriqué et se vend donc
à prix d’or.

msgid:
In this form, Rotom likes to play freezing
cold pranks. You may find it's turned the
bath you just filled to solid ice!
It battles by spewing cold air.
msgstr:
Sous cette forme, Motisma adore les
farces glaciales, comme changer
votre bain en bloc de glace! Il se
bat en soufflant de l’air froid.

msgid:
The first appliance developed that Rotom
coud inspirit was the electric fan. It uses
its power over wind in its pranks, happily
blowing any important documents it finds.
msgstr:
Le ventilateur fut le premier
appareil que Motisma put posséder.
Il manie le vent pour ses farces et
fait voler les documents importants.

msgid:
The lawn mower is an appliance that led to
the development of the Rotom Dex. It will
mow down grass and flowers, then swagger
around with pride at its accomplishments.
msgstr:
La tondeuse est l’appareil qui a
mené au Motismadex. Il tond herbe
et fleurs, puis se pavane, fier de
son exploit.

msgid:
Known as ”The Being of Knowledge,”
according to some sources, this Pokémon
provided people with the intelligence
necessary to solve various problems.
msgstr: Surnommé “l’Etre du Savoir”, il aurait donné\naux humains l’intelligence nécessaire pour\nrésoudre leurs problèmes.

msgid:
Although it slumbers at the bottom of a
lake, its spirit is said to leave its body
and flitter on the water surface. It
taught humans of sorrow, pain, and joy.
msgstr: Il dort au fond d’un lac, mais son esprit\nflotterait à la surface. Il a enseigné aux\nhumains la tristesse, la douleur et la joie.

msgid:
This Pokémon is said to have endowed
humans with the determination needed to
do things. It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit
and Azelf all came from the same egg.
msgstr: Il aurait donné aux humains la volonté\nd’agir. Créhelf, Créfollet et Créfadet\nseraient tous nés du même œuf.

msgid:
A Pokémon spoken of in legend.
It completely controls the flow of time.
It uses its power to travel at will
through the past and future.
msgstr:
Un Pokémon de légende. Il contrôle
entièrement le flux du temps et peut
voyager à sa guise dans le passé et le
futur.

msgid:
Radiant light caused Dialga to take on a
form bearing a striking resemblance to the
creator Pokémon. It wields such a colossal
strength that this might be its true form.
msgstr:
Une lumière radieuse a donné à
Dialga l’allure du Pokémon créateur.
Sa force est si colossale qu’il
pourrait s’agir de sa vraie forme.

msgid:
Palkia has the ability to distort space.
Its total control over the boundaries of
space enable it to transport itself to
faraway places and other dimensions.
msgstr:
Palkia peut distordre l’espace. Il en
maîtrise si bien les limites qu’il peut se
rendre en des lieux lointains ou dans
d’autres dimensions.

msgid:
It soars across the sky in a form that
resembles the creator of all things.
Perhaps this imitation of appearance is a
strategy for gaining Arceus's powers.
msgstr:
Il fend le ciel sous une forme qui
rappelle le créateur de toute chose.
Il l’imite peut-être pour obtenir
les pouvoirs d’Arceus.

msgid:
Boiling blood, like magma, circulates
through its body. It dwells in volcanic
caves, using its cross-shaped feet
to crawl on ceilings and walls.
msgstr:
Un sang bouillant comme le magma coule
dans ses veines. Il vit dans les grottes
volcaniques et rampe aux murs et aux
plafonds.

msgid:
There is an enduring legend that
states this Pokémon shaped Regirock,
Regice, and Registeel out of clay, ice,
and magma.
msgstr: Une légende tenace prétend que ce Pokémon\na modelé Regirock, Regice et Registeel dans\nl’argile, la glace et le magma.

msgid:
This Pokémon is said to live in a world
on the reverse side of ours, where common
knowledge is distorted and strange.
It was banished for its violence.
msgstr: Il vivrait dans un monde inversé, où les\nlois de la nature sont étranges et\ndéformées. Il y fut banni pour sa violence.

msgid:
Giratina loses its legs upon changing into
this form. It's believed it hails from a
world where the heavens and the earth
are as one.
msgstr: Giratina perd ses pattes sous cette\nforme. Il viendrait d’un monde où\nle ciel et la terre ne font qu’un.

msgid:
When the water warms, they inflate the
flotation sac on their heads and drift
languidly on the sea in packs.
It always returns to where it was born.
msgstr: Quand l’eau se réchauffe, ils gonflent leur\nflotteur et dérivent en bande au gré des\nflots. Il revient toujours là où il est né.

msgid:
Water makes up 80% of its body.
It starts its life with a wondrous power
that permits it to bond with any kind
of Pokémon.
msgstr: Son corps est composé à 80 % d’eau. Il naît\navec l’étrange pouvoir de se lier à toutes\nsortes de Pokémon.

msgid:
It chases people and Pokémon from its
territory by causing them to experience
deep, nightmarish slumbers. However,
it means no harm.
msgstr:
Il chasse de son territoire humains et
Pokémon en les plongeant dans de terribles
cauchemars. Pourtant, il ne leur veut aucun
mal.

msgid:
The flowers all over its body bloom if it is
lovingly hugged and senses gratitude. It
dissolves toxins in the air to transform
ruined land into a lush field of flowers.
msgstr:
Les fleurs de son corps éclosent quand on
l’enlace avec tendresse. Il dissout les
toxines de l’air et change les terres
dévastées en champs fleuris.

msgid:
Upon taking in the scent of a particular
rare flower, Shaymin is enveloped in light
and its tiny body transforms, confering
the power of flight upon it.
msgstr:
En respirant le parfum d’une fleur
rare, Shaymin s’entoure de lumière
et son petit corps se transforme,
lui conférant le don de voler.

msgid:
This Pokémon brings victory.
It is said that Trainers with Victini
always win, regardless of the type
of encounter.
msgstr: Un Pokémon qui amène la victoire. On dit que\nles Dresseurs qui le possèdent peuvent\ngagner n’importe quel combat.

msgid:
It is very intelligent and calm.
Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes
its movements swifter. When they are
not feeling well, their tails droop.
msgstr: Il est très intelligent et calme. Le soleil\nrend ses gestes plus vifs. Quand il ne va\npas bien, sa queue retombe.

msgid:
When it gets dirty, its leaves can't be
used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps
clean. They avoid attacks by sinking into
the shadows of thick foliage.
msgstr:
Sale, ses feuilles ne peuvent plus faire la
photosynthèse, alors il reste toujours
propre. Il esquive en se fondant dans les
feuillages.

msgid:
They raise their heads to intimidate foes,
but only give it their all when fighting
powerful opponents who are not fazed
by the glare from its noble eyes.
msgstr: Il dresse la tête pour intimider. Il ne se\ndonne à fond que contre les adversaires\nqui ne cillent pas devant son noble regard.

msgid:
It loves to eat roasted berries, but
sometimes it gets too excited and burns
them to a crisp. It blows fire through
its nose.
msgstr: Il adore les Baies grillées, mais parfois\nl’excitation lui fait les carboniser. Il\ncrache du feu par le nez.

msgid:
The more it eats, the more fuel it has
to make the fire in its stomach stronger.
When it is angered, the intensity of the
flame increases.
msgstr: Plus il mange, plus il a de combustible pour\nattiser le feu de son ventre. Quand il se\nfâche, sa flamme s’intensifie.

msgid:
It is adept at using many different moves.
It can throw a fire punch by setting its
fists on fire with its fiery chin.
It cares deeply about its friends.
msgstr: Il maîtrise de nombreuses capacités. Il\nenflamme ses poings avec sa barbe de feu\npour frapper. Il tient beaucoup à ses amis.

msgid:
The scalchop on its stomach isn't just
used for battle, it can be used to break
open hard berries as well. It is made
from the same element as its claws.
msgstr:
Le coquillage de son ventre lui sert au
combat, mais aussi à ouvrir les Baies dures.
Il est fait de la même matière que ses
griffes.

msgid:
Strict training and disclipine leads it
to master its flowing double-scalchop
technique. Scalchop techniques differ
from one Dewott to another.
msgstr: A force d’entraînement, il maîtrise une\ntechnique fluide à deux coquillages.\nChaque Mateloutre a son propre style.

msgid:
One swing of the seamitars attached
to its armor can fell an opponent.
A simple glare from one of them is
enough to intimidate most enemies.
msgstr:
Un seul coup des épées de son armure abat
un ennemi. Un simple regard de sa part
suffit à intimider la plupart des
adversaires.

msgid:
Hard of heart and deft of blade,
this rare form of Samurott is a
product of the Pokémon's evolution in the
region of Hisui.
msgstr: Cœur de pierre et lame habile, cette forme\nrare de Clamiral est le fruit de son\névolution dans la région de Hisui.

msgid:
Extremely cautious, they take shifts to
maintain a constant watch of their nest.
Using food stored in cheek pouches,
they can keep watch for days.
msgstr:
Très prudents, ils montent la garde à tour
de rôle devant leur nid. Grâce aux vivres
stockés dans leurs joues, ils veillent des
jours.

msgid:
Using luminescent matter, it makes its
eyes and body glow and stuns attacking
opponents. Keen eyesight lets them see
in the dark.
msgstr: Il fait briller ses yeux et son corps pour\naveugler ses ennemis. Sa vue perçante lui\npermet de voir dans le noir.

msgid:
It faces strong opponents with great
courage. Because it doesn't yelp, it's
extremely popular with Trainers who live
in apartment buildings.
msgstr:
Il affronte les ennemis forts avec
courage. Comme il n’aboie pas, il est très
prisé des Dresseurs qui vivent en
appartement.

msgid:
Its dense black fur grows continuously.
The high cost of keeping its hard fur
properly groomed makes this a
troublesome Pokémon to train.
msgstr: Son poil noir et dur pousse sans cesse, et\nson toilettage coûte un bras. Une vraie\nplaie à élever.

msgid:
Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant,
there could be no concern that it would
ever attack people. Some parents even
trust it to babysit.
msgstr:
Intelligent, gentil et courageux, il
n’attaque jamais les gens. Certains
parents lui confient même la garde de leurs
enfants.

msgid:
Their deceptively cute act is the
perfect ruse. They steal from people for
fun, but their victims can't help but
forgive them.
msgstr:
Ses airs mignons sont une ruse parfaite. Il
vole les gens pour s’amuser, mais ses
victimes ne peuvent s’empêcher de lui
pardonner.

msgid:
Many Trainers are drawn to their
beautiful form and fur. These Pokémon
vanish and appear unexpectedly.
They run silently in the night.
msgstr:
Bien des Dresseurs sont séduits par sa
silhouette et son pelage. Il apparaît et
disparaît à l’improviste et court sans
bruit la nuit.

msgid:
This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest.
It's good at finding berries and gathers
them from all over. It's kind enough to
share them with friends.
msgstr: Il vit au fond des forêts. Doué pour\ntrouver les Baies, il en récolte partout et\nles partage volontiers avec ses amis.

msgid:
Ill tempered, it attacks enemies by
swinging its barbed tail around wildly.
The leaf growing on its head is
very bitter.
msgstr: Colérique, il attaque en fouettant l’air de\nsa queue épineuse. La feuille qui pousse\nsur sa tête est très amère.

msgid:
The fire within the tuft on its head can
reach up to 600ºF. Very intelligent,
it roasts berries before eating them.
It likes to help people.
msgstr: Le feu de sa houppe atteint 300 degrés.\nTrès malin, il fait griller les Baies avant de\nles manger. Il aime aider les gens.

msgid:
It loves sweets because they become
energy for the fire burning inside its
body. It scatters embers from its head
and tail to sear its opponents.
msgstr:
Il adore les sucreries, qui nourrissent le
feu de son corps. Il projette des braises
de sa tête et de sa queue pour brûler ses
ennemis.

source: relu et corrigé à la main

msgid:
The water stored inside the tuft of its
head is rich in nutrients. It waters
plants using its tail, plants that
receive its water grow large.
msgstr:
L’eau stockée dans sa houppe est très
nutritive. Il arrose les plantes avec sa
queue, et elles poussent alors très
grandes.

msgid:
It can shoot highly-pressurised water
from its tail with enough power to
break through a solid concrete wall.
It prefers places with clean water.
msgstr: Il projette par la queue de l’eau sous\npression capable de percer un mur en béton.\nIl aime les endroits où l’eau est pure.

msgid:
This Pokémon appears before people
and Pokémon who are having nightmares
and eats those dreams. Munna always
float in the air.
msgstr: Il apparaît devant les gens et les Pokémon\nqui font des cauchemars pour manger leurs\nrêves. Munna flotte toujours dans les airs.

msgid:
The mist emanating from their foreheads
is packed with the dreams of people and
Pokémon. It changes into different colors
depending on the dream that was eaten.
msgstr: La brume de son front est pleine des rêves\ndes gens et des Pokémon. Sa couleur change\nselon le rêve qu’il a mangé.

msgid:
This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for
a new order from its Trainer even though
it already has one. Flocks often gather
in parks and plazas.
msgstr: Ce Pokémon très étourdi attend un ordre de\nson Dresseur même s’il en a déjà reçu un. On\nen voit souvent en groupe dans les parcs.

msgid:
No matter where in the world it goes,
it knows where its nest is, so it can
always return to its Trainer's location
regardless of the distance.
msgstr: Où qu’il aille dans le monde, il sait où est\nson nid et peut toujours retrouver son\nDresseur, quelle que soit la distance.

msgid:
Males have plumage on their heads.
The females' flying abilities surpass
those of the males. They will only let
themselves feel close to their Trainers.
msgstr: Le mâle porte une parure sur la tête. La\nfemelle vole mieux que lui. Ils ne\ns’attachent qu’à leur Dresseur.

source: patch FR actuel (correspondance douteuse, à vérifier)

msgid:
Its mane shines when it discharges
electricity. They use the frequency and
rhythm of these flashes to communicate
with one another.
msgstr: Sa crinière brille quand il produit de\nl’électricité. Il communique grâce à la\nfréquence et au rythme de ces éclairs.

msgid:
When Zebstrika run at full speed, the
sound of thunder reverberates. It is
dangerous when it's angry as it shoots
lightning from its mane in all directions.
msgstr:
Quand Zéblitz court à toute allure, on
entend gronder le tonnerre. En colère, il
lance des éclairs de sa crinière dans tous
les sens.

msgid:
The hexagonal cavity is its ear.
It walks in the direction of sounds it
hears, but if the sounds cease, it panics
and topples over.
msgstr: La cavité hexagonale qu’il arbore est son\noreille. Il fonce vers tout ce qu’il entend,\nmais chute dès que le son s’arrête.

msgid:
Its orange crystal is a mass of energy.
Just one crystal fragment would provide
enough fuel for a hundred dump trucks.
When it is healthy, its core sticks out.
msgstr: Son cristal orange est une masse d’énergie.\nUn seul fragment suffirait à alimenter\ncent camions. En forme, son noyau dépasse.

msgid:
The blasts of energy it makes from
sunbeams have terrifying power.
However, it's not able to fire its blasts
at night or on rainy days.
msgstr: Il absorbe le soleil pour tirer des boules\nd’énergie terriblement destructrices. Une\narme inutilisable la nuit ou s’il pleut.

msgid:
Its habitat is dark forests and caves.
Suction from its nostrils enables it
to stick to cave walls during sleep.
It leaves a heart-shaped mark behind.
msgstr:
Il vit dans les forêts sombres et les
grottes. Son nez-ventouse le colle aux
parois pour dormir. Il y laisse une marque
en forme de cœur.

msgid:
Anyone who comes into contact with
the ultrasonic waves emitted by a
courting male experiences a positive
mood shift.
msgstr: Le mâle courtise la femelle à l’aide\nd’ultrasons. Les écouter met de très bonne\nhumeur.

msgid:
It can dig through the ground at a
speed of 30 mph by spinning its body.
It could give a car running aboveground
a good race.
msgstr: Il creuse le sol à 50 km/h en tournoyant. Il\npourrait faire la course avec une voiture\nroulant en surface.

msgid:
More than 300 feet below the surface,
they build mazelike nests. Their activity
can be destructive to subway tunnels,
but it can also help with construction.
msgstr:
Il creuse des nids labyrinthiques à cent
mètres sous terre. Il peut abîmer les
tunnels de métro, mais aussi aider à les
construire.

msgid:
Its auditory sense is astounding.
Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell
how someone is feeling or when an egg
might hatch.
msgstr: Son ouïe est extraordinaire. Ses antennes\nlui permettent de deviner l’humeur des gens\nou le moment où un Œuf va éclore.

msgid:
These Pokémon appear at building
sites and help out with construction.
They always carry squared logs.
As they grow, they carry bigger logs.
msgstr:
Il apparaît sur les chantiers pour aider à
la construction. Il porte toujours une
poutre, de plus en plus grosse à mesure
qu’il grandit.

msgid:
They strengthen their bodies by carrying
steel beams. This Pokémon is so muscular
and strongly built that even a group of
wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.
msgstr:
Il se muscle en portant des poutres
d’acier. Il est si costaud que même une
bande de catcheurs ne parvient pas à le
faire bouger.

msgid:
They use concrete pillars as walking
canes. Rather than rely solely on force,
they master moves that utilize the
centrifugal force of spinning concrete.
msgstr:
Il se sert de piliers de béton comme
cannes. Au lieu de la force brute, il
maîtrise des techniques utilisant leur
force centrifuge.

msgid:
By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound
waves imperceptible to humans. It uses
the rhythm of these sounds to talk and
warns others of danger.
msgstr: Il fait vibrer ses joues pour émettre des\nsons inaudibles pour les humains. Il s’en\nsert pour parler et prévenir du danger.

msgid:
It lives in the water and on land.
When they vibrate the bumps on their
heads, they can make waves in water
or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
msgstr: Il vit dans l’eau et sur terre. En faisant\nvibrer ses bosses, il crée des vagues dans\nl’eau et des secousses sur terre.

msgid:
It increases the power of its punches
by vibrating the bumps on its fists.
They can also shoot paralyzing liquid
from their head bumps.
msgstr: Il fait vibrer les bosses de ses poings\npour frapper plus fort. Celles de sa tête\nprojettent un liquide paralysant.

msgid:
When it tightens its belt, it becomes
stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave
their own belts. It changes belts as it
gets more powerful.
msgstr: Il devient plus fort en serrant sa\nceinture, tressée de lianes. Il en change à\nmesure qu’il gagne en puissance.

msgid:
The sound of Sawk punching boulders
and trees can be heard all the way from
the mountains where they train.
Disturbing their training angers them.
msgstr: On entend jusqu’au pied des montagnes\nKaraclée frapper rochers et arbres. Gare à\nqui dérange son entraînement!

msgid:
It chews up leaves and sews them with
sticky thread extruded from its mouth.
Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes,
it is a mascot for fashion designers.
msgstr: Il mâche des feuilles et les coud avec le\nfil gluant de sa bouche. Il fait ses propres\nhabits: c’est la mascotte des stylistes.

msgid:
Forests where Swadloon live have
superb foliage because the nutrients
they make from fallen leaves nourish
the plant life.
msgstr: Dans les forêts où il vit, la végétation\npousse bien car il transforme les feuilles\nmortes en engrais.

msgid:
It keeps its eggs warm with heat from
fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to
weave warm wrappings for Sewaddle by
using the silk secreted from its mouth.
msgstr:
Il couve ses œufs à la chaleur de feuilles
qui fermentent. Il tisse aussi des langes
de feuilles pour les Larveyette avec sa
soie.

msgid:
Using the feelers on its head and tail,
it picks up vibrations in the air to
determine its prey's location and state.
It is brutally aggressive.
msgstr: Ses antennes captent les vibrations de\nl’air pour repérer ses proies et leur état.\nIl est d’une agressivité redoutable.

msgid:
Storing energy for evolution, it sits.
But when attacked, it spins its body at
high speed like a wheel and then
crashes furiously into its opponent.
msgstr: Immobile, il accumule de l’énergie pour\névoluer. Attaqué, il tourne sur lui-même\ncomme une roue et fonce sur l’ennemi.

msgid:
With quick movements, it chases down
its foes, attacking relentlessly with its
horns until it prevails. Then it finishes
them off with deadly poison.
msgstr: Il traque ses ennemis à toute vitesse et\nles frappe sans relâche de ses cornes, puis\nles achève avec un poison mortel.

msgid:
When it finds others of its kind, they all
stick together. When enough of them
have collected, the mass resembles a
cumulonimbus cloud.
msgstr:
Les Doudouvet se collent entre eux quand
ils se rencontrent. Assez nombreux, ils
forment de véritables cumulonimbus
vivants.

msgid:
It rides on the wind and slips into
people's homes. After it has turned a
room into a cotton-filled mess, it giggles
to itself and takes off.
msgstr: Il s’introduit chez les gens à la faveur\nd’un courant d’air, répand du coton partout\ndans la pièce puis repart en riant.

msgid:
By pruning the leaves on its head with
regularity, this Pokémon can be grown
into a fine plump shape. These bitter
leaves refresh those who eat them.
msgstr: En taillant régulièrement les feuilles de sa\ntête, on lui donne une jolie forme ronde.\nCes feuilles amères sont revigorantes.

msgid:
Even veteran Trainers face a challenge
in getting its beautiful flower to bloom.
It withers away if a trainer does not
take good care of it.
msgstr: Même les Dresseurs chevronnés peinent à\nfaire éclore sa belle fleur. Il se fane si on\nne prend pas bien soin de lui.

msgid:
Its well-developed legs are the result of
a life spent on mountains covered in deep
snow. The scent it exudes from its flower
crown heartens those in proximity.
msgstr:
Ses jambes puissantes sont le fruit d’une
vie passée dans des montagnes enneigées.
Le parfum de sa couronne de fleurs ravive
le cœur de ceux qui l’entourent.

msgid:
It used to be a common food source. The
meat of red Basculin is on the fatty side
and it's more popular with the youth.
Its temperament is vicious and aggressive.
msgstr: Il était autrefois très consommé. La chair\ndu Bargantua rouge est grasse et plaît aux\njeunes. Il est d’un naturel violent.

msgid:
They form schools with others of the same
color. The greatest foe of a school of blue
Basculin is a school of red Basculin.
Its flavor is light and inoffensive.
msgstr:
Ils forment des bancs de même
couleur. Le pire ennemi d’un banc
de Bargantua bleus est un banc de
rouges. Sa chair a un goût léger.

msgid:
While this ancient form of Basculin shares
a vast array of qualities with other forms,
it differs in several respects, including
demeanor, being much gentler than others.
msgstr:
Cette forme ancienne de Bargantua
partage bien des traits avec les
autres, mais s’en distingue par un
tempérament bien plus doux.

msgid:
Clads itself in the souls of comrades that
perished before fulfilling their goals of
journeying upstream. No other species in
all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.
msgstr:
Il se revêt des âmes de ses camarades
morts avant d’avoir pu remonter le courant.
Dans les rivières de Hisui, nul n’égale
Paragruel.

msgid: The souls of its comrades cloak its\nbody and propel it effortlessly\nthrough even raging rapids.
msgstr: Les âmes de ses camarades\nenveloppent son corps et le propulsent\nmême dans les rapides déchaînés.

msgid:
It conceals itself in the sand and
chomps down on the legs of any prey
that unwarily walk over it. Its favorite
food is Trapinch.
msgstr: Tapi dans le sable, il attend qu’une proie\npasse pour lui croquer la patte. Il a un\ngros faible pour les Kraknoix.

msgid:
They move in groups of a few individuals.
Thanks to the special membrane covering
its eyes, it can see its surroundings
clearly, even in the dead of night.
msgstr: Il vit en petits groupes. Une membrane\nspéciale protège ses yeux et lui permet de\nvoir clair même en pleine nuit.

msgid:
Very violent Pokémon, they never allow
their prey to escape. Their jaws are so
powerful, they can crush the body of
an automobile.
msgstr: Ce Pokémon très violent ne laisse jamais sa\nproie s’échapper. Ses mâchoires peuvent\nbroyer la carrosserie d’une voiture.

msgid:
When its internal fire is burning, it
cannot calm down and it runs around.
When the fire diminishes, it pulls its
limbs into its body and falls asleep.
msgstr: Quand son feu intérieur brûle, il ne tient\npas en place et court partout. Quand il\nfaiblit, il rentre ses membres et s’endort.

msgid:
When one is injured in a fierce battle,
it transforms into a stone statue.
Then it meditates and sharpens its
mind and fights on mentally.
msgstr: Gravement blessé au combat, il se change\nen statue de pierre. Il médite alors pour\naffûter son esprit et poursuivre la lutte.

msgid: When wounded, it stops moving. It\ngoes as still as stone to meditate,\nsharpening its mind and spirit.
msgstr: Blessé, il cesse de bouger et reste\nimmobile comme une pierre pour\nméditer et aiguiser son esprit.

msgid:
The colder they get, the more
energetic they are. They freeze their
breath to make snowballs, using them
as ammo for playful snowball fights.
msgstr:
Plus il fait froid, plus il est en forme. Il
gèle son souffle pour faire des boules de
neige, qu’il utilise dans de joyeuses
batailles.

msgid:
On days when blizzards blow
through, it comes down to where people
live. It stashes food in the snowball on
its head, taking it home for later.
msgstr:
Les jours de blizzard, il descend près des
villages. Il cache de la nourriture dans la
boule de neige sur sa tête pour la
rapporter chez lui.

msgid:
Darmanitan takes this form when
enraged. It won't stop spewing flames
until its rage has settled, even if
its body starts to melt.
msgstr:
Darumacho prend cette forme quand il
enrage. Il crache des flammes tant
que sa colère n’est pas retombée,
même si son corps se met à fondre.

msgid:
Arid regions are their habitat.
When it moves rhythmically, it makes a
sound similar to maracas, making the
surprised Pokémon flee.
msgstr: Il vit dans les régions arides. En se\ndéhanchant, il produit un son de maracas\nqui fait fuir les Pokémon surpris.

msgid:
It makes a hole in a stone of a suitable
size. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon
remains agitated until it locates
a replacement.
msgstr: Il creuse un trou dans une pierre à sa\ntaille. Si elle se brise, il reste agité\njusqu’à ce qu’il en trouve une autre.

msgid:
Competing for territory, Crustle fight
viciously. The one whose boulder is
broken is the loser of the battle and
begins to weaken.
msgstr: Ils se battent férocement pour leur\nterritoire. Celui dont le rocher se brise a\nperdu et commence à dépérir.

msgid:
Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it
can reduce damage by defensively
pulling its skin up to its neck.
Its skull is massively thick.
msgstr: Sa peau élastique lui permet d’amortir les\ncoups en la remontant jusqu’au cou. Son\ncrâne est extrêmement épais.

msgid:
Groups of them beat up anything that
enters their territory. The one with the
biggest crest is the group leader, and
is the most respected.
msgstr: Ils rossent en groupe tout ce qui entre sur\nleur territoire. Celui qui a la plus grande\ncrête est le chef, et le plus respecté.

msgid:
The guardians of an ancient city, they
always fly the same route while keeping
watch for invaders. They use their
psychic power to attack enemies.
msgstr:
Gardiens d’une cité antique, ils survolent
toujours le même trajet pour guetter les
intrus et attaquent par la force
psychique.

msgid:
These Pokémon arose from the spirits
of people interred in graves in past ages.
Each of them carries a mask that used
to be its face when it was human.
msgstr:
Ces Pokémon sont nés des âmes de gens
enterrés jadis. Ils portent tous un masque,
qui était leur visage quand ils étaient
humains.

msgid:
Grave robbers who mistake them for
real coffins and get too close end up
trapped inside their bodies. Their bodies
are covered in pure gold.
msgstr: Les pilleurs de tombes qui le prennent pour\nun vrai sarcophage finissent piégés dans\nson corps, recouvert d’or pur.

msgid:
A clay slab with cursed engravings
took possession of a Yamask. The
slab is said to be absorbing the
Yamask's dark power.
msgstr: Une tablette d’argile gravée de\nmalédictions s’est emparée d’un Tutafeh.\nElle absorberait son énergie maléfique.

msgid: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient\npainting. After absorbing the spirit of\na Yamask, the painting began to move.
msgstr: Ces motifs antiques gravés d’une\npuissante malédiction ont aspiré l’âme de\nTutafeh avant de prendre vie.

msgid:
Reputed to be the ancestor of most
turtle Pokémon, it lived in warm seas
about a hundred million years ago.
It was restored from a fossil.
msgstr:
Ancêtre de la plupart des Pokémon tortues,
il vivait dans les mers chaudes il y a 100
millions d’années. Il a été ressuscité d’un
fossile.

msgid:
They can live both in the ocean and
on land. Incredible jaw strength enables
them to chew up steel beams and rocks
along with their prey.
msgstr: Il vit dans la mer comme sur terre. Ses\nmâchoires surpuissantes broient poutres\nd’acier et rochers avec ses proies.

msgid:
Said to be the ancestor of all bird
Pokémon, Archen itself could not actually
fly but moved by hopping from treetop
to treetop.
msgstr: On dit qu’il est l’ancêtre des oiseaux.\nIncapable de voler, il se déplaçait en\nsautant de cime en cime.

msgid:
They are intelligent and will cooperate
to catch prey. When one Archeops
had the prey cornered, another would
swoop on it.
msgstr: Ils sont intelligents et chassent en\néquipe. Quand un Aéroptéryx acculait une\nproie, un autre fondait sur elle.

msgid:
It gorges on trash until its stomach
is full. Then it belches toxic gas.
An unlucky whiff of this gas will put
a person in the hospital.
msgstr: Il se gave d’ordures jusqu’à plus faim, puis\nrote un gaz toxique. Une bouffée suffit à\nenvoyer quelqu’un à l’hôpital.

msgid:
Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots
from its right arm. If even a little of it
gets on you, you'll experience the full
effects of this unidentified toxin.
msgstr: Gare au liquide toxique qu’il projette par\nson bras droit! Une seule goutte suffit à\nsubir tous les effets de ce poison inconnu.

msgid:
To protect themselves from danger, they
hide their true identities by transforming
into people and Pokémon. Apparently, it
often transforms into a silent child.
msgstr:
Pour se protéger, ils cachent leur identité
en prenant l’apparence de gens ou de
Pokémon. Il se change souvent en enfant
silencieux.

msgid:
Bonds between these Pokémon are very
strong. It protects the safety of its
pack by tricking its opponents. They
defend their lair with illusory scenery.
msgstr: Très solidaires, ils protègent la meute en\ndupant leurs ennemis. Ils défendent leur\ntanière avec des paysages illusoires.

msgid:
Derives power from resentment,
which rises as energy atop its head and
takes on the forms of foes. In this
way, Zorua vents lingering malice.
msgstr:
Il puise sa force dans la rancune, qui
s’élève au-dessus de sa tête et prend la
forme de ses ennemis. Ainsi, Zorua exprime
sa malveillance tenace.

msgid:
Heedless of its own safety,
Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter
energy so intense, it lacerates
Zoroark's own body.
msgstr: Insouciant du danger, Zoroark attaque ses\nennemis avec une rancœur si intense\nqu’elle lacère son propre corps.

msgid:
These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat.
They greet one another by rubbing each
other with their tails, which are always
kept well groomed and clean.
msgstr: Ces Pokémon aiment la propreté. Ils se\nsaluent en se frottant avec leur queue,\ntoujours bien entretenue.

msgid:
Their white fur feels amazing to touch.
Cinccino's body is coated in a special
oil that repels dust and helps it deflect
attacks, such as punches.
msgstr:
Son pelage blanc est merveilleusement
doux. Une huile spéciale le protège de la
poussière et fait glisser les coups de
poing.

msgid:
They intently observe both Trainers and
Pokémon. Apparently, Gothita are looking
at something that only they can see. Their
ribbonlike feelers increase their power.
msgstr:
Ils observent intensément Dresseurs et
Pokémon. On dirait qu’ils voient des choses
invisibles aux autres. Leurs rubans
décuplent leur force.

msgid:
Starlight is the source of their power.
They use hypnosis to control people and
Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading them
astray are told in every corner.
msgstr:
La lumière des étoiles leur donne leur
force. Ils hypnotisent humains et Pokémon.
Partout, on raconte qu’ils égarent les
gens.

msgid:
Starry skies thousands of light-years
away are visible in the space distorted by
their intense psychic power. When it learns
its Trainer's life span, it cries in sadness.
msgstr:
Sa puissance psychique distord l’espace et
révèle des cieux à des années-lumière. Il
pleure en apprenant l’espérance de vie de
son Dresseur.

msgid:
Because their bodies are enveloped
in a special liquid, they are fine in any
environment, no matter how severe. They
can use telepathy to talk with others.
msgstr: Enveloppés d’un liquide spécial, ils\nsupportent les milieux les plus hostiles.\nIls communiquent par télépathie.

msgid:
When their brains, now divided in two,
are thinking the same thoughts,
these Pokémon exhibit their maximized
psychic power.
msgstr: Quand ses deux moitiés de cerveau ont la\nmême pensée, ce Pokémon déploie toute sa\npuissance psychique.

msgid:
They use psychic power to control their
arms, which are made of a special liquid.
When Reuniclus shake hands, a network
forms between their brains.
msgstr:
Ils contrôlent par psychokinèse leurs bras
faits d’un liquide spécial. Quand deux
Symbios se serrent la main, leurs cerveaux
se relient.

msgid:
These bird Pokémon are excellent divers.
They are better at swimming than flying,
and they happily eat their favorite food,
peat moss, as they dive underwater.
msgstr:
Ces Pokémon oiseaux plongent à merveille.
Ils nagent mieux qu’ils ne volent et
dégustent sous l’eau leur mets favori: la
tourbe.

msgid:
Despite their elegant appearance, they
can flap their wings strongly and fly for
thousands of miles. The one in the middle
is the leader of the flock.
msgstr: Malgré leur air élégant, leurs puissantes\nailes leur font parcourir des milliers de\nkilomètres. Celui du milieu guide la nuée.

msgid:
The temperature of their breath is -58ºF.
They create snow crystals and make snow
fall in the areas around them. Vanillite is
treasured by households in warm regions.
msgstr: Son souffle est à -50 degrés et fait\ntomber la neige autour de lui. Les foyers\ndes régions chaudes adorent les Sorbébé.

msgid:
Vanillish has existed since the Ice Age.
It controls particles of ice, freezes its
opponents, and then shatters them with
a headbutt.
msgstr: Sorboul existe depuis l’ère glaciaire. Il\ncontrôle des particules de glace, gèle ses\nennemis, puis les brise d’un coup de tête.

msgid:
Each of its two heads has a brain, and
when they are in agreement, it attacks
its enemies by exhaling a violent blizzard.
It makes snow clouds inside its body.
msgstr:
Chacune de ses deux têtes a un cerveau.
Quand elles sont d’accord, il souffle un
violent blizzard. Il crée des nuages de
neige en lui.

msgid:
Deerling have different scents
depending on the season. In early
spring, these Pokémon give off a
delicate, sweet, and calming scent.
msgstr: Leur odeur change selon la saison. Au début\ndu printemps, ils dégagent un parfum\ndélicat, sucré et apaisant.

msgid:
To prevent Deerling from entering
their fields, many farmers will have
several Lycanroc stand guard, as
they are its natural enemy.
msgstr:
Pour tenir les Vivaldaim loin de
leurs champs, bien des fermiers les
font garder par des Lougaroc, leurs
prédateurs naturels.

msgid:
Deerling have different scents
depending on the season. In this form,
Deerling have a softly sweet scent
that lingers in the nose.
msgstr:
L’odeur de Vivaldaim varie selon la
saison. Sous cette forme, il dégage
un parfum doux et sucré qui reste
longtemps dans le nez.

msgid:
Deerling's scent changes with the
seasons, but when the Pokémon is in
its Winter Form, it has hardly any
scent at all.
msgstr: L’odeur de Vivaldaim change selon\nla saison, mais sous sa Forme Hiver,\nil n’en a presque aucune.

msgid:
Some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers
of spring because the plants growing on
its horns change according to the season.
The leader possesses magnificent horns.
msgstr:
On les dit messagers du printemps, car les
plantes de leurs bois changent au fil des
saisons. Le chef porte des bois
magnifiques.

msgid:
The thicker and larger the
branches and leaves on its antlers, the
more majestic the Sawsbuck is thought
to be.
msgstr: Plus les branches et feuilles de ses\nbois sont épaisses et grandes, plus\nce Haydaim est jugé majestueux.

msgid:
Sawsbuck in their Autumn Form are
known for having very short
tempers. The males fight each other
incessantly.
msgstr:
Les Haydaim en Forme Automne sont
connus pour leur caractère
colérique. Les mâles se battent
sans cesse.

msgid:
Though there are many enthusiasts
for Sawsbuck as a species, this
seasonal form in particular is not
very popular.
msgstr:
Si Haydaim a de nombreux fans en
tant qu’espèce, cette forme
saisonnière n’est guère
populaire.

msgid:
It glides using its cape-like membrane.
It grills berries and bug Pokémon with
electric shocks from the pouches on its
cheeks and makes a meal of them.
msgstr:
Il plane grâce à sa membrane en forme de
cape. Il grille Baies et Pokémon insectes
avec l’électricité de ses joues et s’en
régale.

msgid:
When they feel threatened, they spit an
acidic liquid to drive attackers away.
For some reason they evolve while they
are in the same place as Shelmet.
msgstr:
Menacé, il crache un liquide acide pour
faire fuir ses ennemis. Pour une raison
obscure, il évolue en présence d’un
Escargaume.

msgid:
Wearing the shell covering they stole
from Shelmet, they defend themselves and
attack with two lances. The steel armor
protects their whole body.
msgstr:
Revêtus de la coquille volée à un
Escargaume, ils se défendent et attaquent
avec deux lances. Leur armure d’acier les
protège tout entiers.

msgid:
It lures Pokémon in with its pattern that
looks just like a Poké Ball, then releases
its poison spores. Why it resembles a
Poké Ball is unknown.
msgstr:
Il attire les Pokémon avec son motif de
Poké Ball, puis libère ses spores toxiques.
On ignore pourquoi il ressemble à une Poké
Ball.

msgid:
It lures prey close by dancing and waving
its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls,
in a swaying motion, but very few Pokémon
are fooled by this.
msgstr:
Il attire ses proies en dansant et en
agitant ses bras en forme de Poké Ball,
mais très peu de Pokémon s’y laissent
prendre.

msgid:
If its veil-like arms stun and wrap an
opponent, that foe will be dragged
five miles below the surface to its lair,
never to return.
msgstr:
Si ses bras en voile paralysent et enlacent
un ennemi, celui-ci est entraîné à huit
kilomètres sous l’eau, dans son repaire, à
jamais.

msgid:
They propel themselves by expelling
absorbed seawater from their bodies.
It's said there's a castle of ships
Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.
msgstr:
Il se propulse en expulsant l’eau de mer
qu’il absorbe. Les Moyade auraient un
château fait de navires coulés au fond des
mers.

msgid:
When they find a wounded Pokémon,
they embrace it and bring it to shore.
The special membrane enveloping
Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.
msgstr: Quand il trouve un Pokémon blessé, il\nl’enlace et le ramène au rivage. La membrane\nqui l’enveloppe a le pouvoir de guérir.

msgid:
Since they can't generate their own
electricity, they attach themselves to
large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static
electricity, which they store in a pouch.
msgstr: Incapable de produire de l’électricité, il\ns’accroche à de gros Pokémon pour absorber\nleur électricité statique et la stocker.

msgid:
It creates barriers from electrified silk
that stun foes. This works as a weapon as
well as a defense. While it is immobilized
by shock, they leisurely consume it.
msgstr:
Il tisse des toiles de soie électrifiée qui
paralysent ses ennemis, à la fois arme et
défense. Il dévore ensuite sa proie sans se
presser.

msgid:
It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock
while clinging to the ceiling of caves.
When threatened, it attacks by shooting
a barrage of spikes.
msgstr: Accroché au plafond des grottes, il\nabsorbe le fer de la roche. Menacé, il\nattaque en tirant une salve de pointes.

msgid:
It fights by swinging around its three
spiky feelers and shooting spikes.
A hit from these steel spikes can reduce
a boulder to rubble.
msgstr:
Il combat en faisant tournoyer ses trois
tentacules et en tirant des pointes
d’acier capables de réduire un rocher en
miettes.

msgid:
Two bodies comprise a fixed pair.
The two minigears that mesh together
are predetermined. Each will rebound from
other minigears without meshing.
msgstr: Ses deux corps forment un duo inséparable.\nLeurs engrenages ne s’emboîtent qu’entre\neux et rebondissent sur tous les autres.

source: patch FR actuel (correspondance douteuse, à vérifier)

msgid:
A minigear and big gear comprise its
body. Spinning minigears are rotated
at high speed and repeatedly fired away.
It is dangerous if the gears don't return.
msgstr:
Son corps est formé d’un petit et d’un
grand engrenage. Il lance le petit en le
faisant tourner très vite. Gare s’il ne
revient pas!

msgid:
Its red core functions as an energy tank.
It is rotated at high speed for a rapid
energy charge. It fires the charged energy
through its spikes into an area.
msgstr:
Son noyau rouge lui sert de réservoir
d’énergie. Il le fait tourner très vite pour
se recharger, puis libère l’énergie par ses
pointes.

msgid:
These Pokémon move in schools.
One alone can emit only a trickle of
electricity, so a group of them gathers
to unleash a powerful electric shock.
msgstr:
Ils se déplacent en bancs. Seul, il ne
produit qu’un filet d’électricité, alors ils
se regroupent pour lancer de puissantes
décharges.

msgid:
These Pokémon have a big appetite.
It wraps itself around its prey and
paralyzes it with electricity from the
round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.
msgstr:
Ce Pokémon est très vorace. Il s’enroule
autour de sa proie, la paralyse avec les
taches rondes de ses flancs, puis la
croque.

msgid:
They crawl out of the ocean using their
arms. They will attack prey on shore and
immediately drag it into the ocean, with
their sucker mouths.
msgstr:
Il sort de l’océan à la force des bras. Il
attaque les proies sur le rivage et les
entraîne aussitôt sous l’eau avec sa
bouche-ventouse.

msgid:
It psychically squeezes the brain of
its foe, causing unendurable headaches.
Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO
crash site in the desert 50 years ago.
msgstr: Il compresse le cerveau de ses ennemis par\ntélékinésie, causant d’atroces migraines.\nOn le lie à un crash d’OVNI dans le désert.

msgid:
It can manipulate an opponent's memory.
Apparently, it communicates by flashing
its three fingers, but those patterns
haven't been decoded.
msgstr: Il peut manipuler la mémoire de ses ennemis.\nIl communiquerait en faisant clignoter ses\ntrois doigts, mais nul n’a percé ce code.

msgid:
While Litwick shines a light and pretends
to be a guide, it absorbs the life force of
any who follow it, which becomes the fuel
that it burns.
msgstr: Funécire fait mine de guider les gens avec\nsa lumière, mais absorbe l’énergie vitale de\nceux qui le suivent pour nourrir sa flamme.

msgid:
This ominous Pokémon is feared.
Through cities it wanders, searching
for the spirits of the fallen. The spirits
it absorbs fuel its baleful fire.
msgstr: Ce Pokémon sinistre erre dans les villes en\nquête d’âmes défuntes. Les âmes qu’il\nabsorbe alimentent son feu funeste.

msgid:
Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns
up the spirit, leaving the body behind.
By waving the flames on its arms, it puts
its foes into a hypnotic trance.
msgstr:
Sa flamme brûle l’âme et ne laisse que le
corps. En agitant les flammes de ses bras,
il plonge ses ennemis dans une transe
hypnotique.

source: relu et corrigé à la main

msgid:
They mark their territory by leaving
gashes in trees with their tusks. If a
tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly,
harder and sturdier than the last.
msgstr: Il marque son territoire en entaillant les\narbres de ses défenses. Si l’une casse, une\nnouvelle repousse vite, encore plus solide.

msgid:
Their tusks can shatter rocks.
A broken tusk will not grow back,
so it diligently sharpens its tusks on
river rocks after the end of a battle.
msgstr: Ses défenses brisent la roche. Une défense\ncassée ne repousse pas, alors il les aiguise\navec soin sur les rochers des rivières.

msgid:
They are kind but can be relentless
when defending territory. Their sturdy
tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut
steel beams.
msgstr:
Gentils mais impitoyables quand ils
défendent leur territoire, ils ont des
défenses qui restent tranchantes même sur
des poutres d’acier.

msgid:
Its nose is always running.
Their snot is a barometer of health.
When healthy, their snot is sticky and
the power of their ice moves increases.
msgstr: Son nez coule sans arrêt et sa morve trahit\nsa santé: quand il va bien, elle est collante\net ses capacités Glace sont plus fortes.

msgid:
It freezes its breath to create fangs
and claws of ice to fight with.
Very able in the water, it swims around
in northern seas and catches prey.
msgstr: Il gèle son souffle pour se faire des crocs\net des griffes de glace. Très à l’aise dans\nl’eau, il chasse dans les mers du Nord.

msgid:
They are born in snow clouds. When
its body temperature goes up, it turns
into steam and vanishes. When its
temperature lowers, it returns to ice.
msgstr:
Il naît dans les nuages de neige. Si sa
température monte, il se change en vapeur
et disparaît. Quand elle baisse, il
redevient glace.

msgid:
When attacked, it defends itself by
closing the lid of its shell. It evolves
when bathed in an electric-like energy
along with Karrablast.
msgstr:
Attaqué, il se défend en fermant le
couvercle de sa coquille. Il évolue s’il
reçoit une énergie électrique avec
Carabing.

msgid:
When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to
prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in
layers of thin membrane. It is very light
and fights with ninja-like movements.
msgstr: Quand il se dessèche, il faiblit. Pour\nl’éviter, il s’enveloppe de fines membranes.\nTrès léger, il combat comme un ninja.

msgid:
It conceals itself in the mud of the
seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch
it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.
It smiles when transmitting electricity.
msgstr:
Il se cache dans la boue du rivage et
attend. Quand une proie le touche, il
l’électrocute. Il sourit quand il envoie du
courant.

msgid:
Its conspicuous lips lure prey in
as it lies in wait in the mud. When
prey gets close, Stunfisk clamps its
jagged steel fins down on them.
msgstr:
Tapi dans la boue, il attire ses proies avec
ses lèvres voyantes. Quand elles
approchent, Limonde les broie entre ses
nageoires d’acier dentelées.

msgid:
They have mastered elegant combos.
As they concentrate, their battle moves
become swifter and more precise. What it
lacks in power, it makes up for in quantity.
msgstr:
Il maîtrise d’élégants enchaînements, plus
vifs et précis à mesure qu’il se concentre.
Il compense son manque de force par le
nombre.

msgid:
They use the long fur on their arms as
a whip to strike their opponents. Its arm
attacks come with such rapidity that they
cannot even be seen.
msgstr: Il fouette ses ennemis avec les longs poils\nde ses bras. Ses attaques sont si rapides\nqu’elles en deviennent invisibles.

msgid:
It warms its body by absorbing sunlight
with its wings. When its body temperature
falls, it can no longer move. It uses its
sharp claws to catch prey.
msgstr:
Il se réchauffe en absorbant le soleil avec
ses ailes. Si sa température baisse, il ne
peut plus bouger. Ses griffes attrapent
ses proies.

msgid:
These Pokémon are thought to have
been created by the science of an
ancient and mysterious civilization.
It's been active for thousands of years.
msgstr:
Ces Pokémon auraient été créés par la
science d’une mystérieuse civilisation
antique. Ils sont actifs depuis des
millénaires.

msgid:
Golurk were created to protect people
and Pokémon by an ancient civilisation.
Removing the seal on its chest makes its
internal energy go out of control.
msgstr:
Une civilisation antique l’a créé pour
protéger les gens et les Pokémon. Si on
retire le sceau de son torse, son énergie
se déchaîne.

msgid:
Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by
sinking the blades that cover their bodies
into their prey. If battling dulls them, it
sharpens them on stones by the river.
msgstr:
Insensibles aux blessures, ils attaquent
en groupe et plantent leurs lames dans
leurs proies. Ils les aiguisent sur les
pierres des rivières.

msgid:
This pitiless Pokémon commands a group
of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility.
It battles to become the boss, but will be
driven from the group if it loses.
msgstr:
Ce Pokémon sans pitié commande des
Scalpion qui traquent ses proies. Il se bat
pour être le chef et est chassé du groupe
s’il perd.

msgid:
Though it commands a massive army
in battle, it's not skilled at
devising complex strategies. It just uses
brute strength to keep pushing.
msgstr:
Il commande une immense armée, mais
n’est pas doué pour les stratégies
complexes. Il se contente d’avancer
par la force brute.

msgid:
Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even
if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
Their headbutts have enough destructive
force to derail a train.
msgstr: Son pelage touffu amortit les chocs de ses\nviolents coups de tête, assez puissants\npour faire dérailler un train.

msgid:
With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces
its prey, and then it pecks at them.
Although it also consumes berries, it's a
carnivore at heart.
msgstr:
Il agrippe ses proies avec ses serres
effilées et les picore. Il lui arrive de
manger des Baies, mais au fond c’est un
carnivore.

msgid:
For the sake of its friends, this brave
warrior of the sky will not stop battling,
even if it is injured. One can carry a car
while flying.
msgstr: Pour ses amis, ce brave guerrier du ciel\ncombat même blessé. Il peut soulever une\nvoiture en plein vol.

msgid: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle\ncry, this huge and ferocious bird\nPokémon goes out on the hunt.
msgstr: Ce grand oiseau féroce part à la chasse en\npoussant un cri de guerre à glacer le sang.

msgid:
It can't fly yet and must wait until its
wings have developed more. They guard
their posteriors with bones that were
gathered by Mandibuzz.
msgstr: Il ne sait pas encore voler et attend que\nses ailes poussent. Il protège son derrière\navec des os rassemblés par Vaututrice.

msgid:
They adorn themselves beautifully with
bones. This is supposedly an effort to
attract males, but no male Mandibuzz
have ever been found.
msgstr: Les Vaututrice se parent d’ossements pour\nleur parade nuptiale. On attend toujours\nde découvrir si les mâles existent.

msgid:
It draws in air through its tail,
transforms it into fire, and uses it like
a tongue. They burn through Durant's steel
bodies and consume their insides.
msgstr: Il aspire l’air par la queue et le change en\nflammes qui lui servent de langue. Il perce\nl’armure des Fermite pour les dévorer.

msgid:
Durant dig nests in mountains.
Individuals each play different roles in
driving Heatmor, their natural predator,
away from their colony.
msgstr:
Les Fermite creusent leurs nids en
montagne. Chacun joue un rôle pour
repousser Aflamanoir, leur prédateur
naturel.

msgid:
Lacking sight, it's unaware of its
surroundings, so it bumps into things and
eats anything that moves. Approaching
it carelessly is dangerous.
msgstr: Aveugle, il se cogne partout et mord tout\nce qui bouge. Il est dangereux de\nl’approcher sans précaution.

msgid:
After it has eaten up all the food in its
territory, it moves on to another area.
Whichever head eats more than the other
gets to be the leader.
msgstr: Après avoir dévoré toute la nourriture de\nson territoire, il part ailleurs. La tête qui\nmange le plus devient le chef.

msgid:
This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on
its six wings. The heads on their arms do
not have brains. They use all three heads
to consume and destroy everything.
msgstr: Ce Pokémon brutal sillonne le ciel sur ses\nsix ailes. Les têtes de ses bras n’ont pas\nde cerveau. Ses trois têtes dévorent tout.

msgid:
This Pokémon was believed to have
been born from the sun. It spews fire from
its horns and encases itself in a cocoon
of fire when it evolves.
msgstr:
On pensait que ce Pokémon était né du
soleil. Il crache du feu par ses cornes et
s’enferme dans un cocon de feu pour
évoluer.

msgid:
When volcanic ash darkened the
atmosphere, it appeared and saved Pokémon
from freezing, Volcarona's fire provided a
replacement for the sun.
msgstr: Quand des cendres volcaniques ont\nobscurci le ciel, son feu a remplacé le\nsoleil et sauvé les Pokémon du froid.

msgid:
It has a body and heart of steel. This
legendary Pokémon battled against humans
to protect Pokémon. Its personality
is calm and composed.
msgstr: Il a un corps et un cœur d’acier. Ce Pokémon\nlégendaire a combattu les humains pour\nprotéger les Pokémon. Il est calme et posé.

msgid:
Spoken of in legend, this Pokémon used
its phenomenal power to destroy a castle
in its effort to protect Pokémon that had
lost their homes in a war among humans.
msgstr:
Ce Pokémon légendaire a détruit un château
de sa force colossale pour protéger les
Pokémon privés de foyer par une guerre
humaine.

msgid:
Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades.
Legends say this Pokémon used
whirlwind-like movements to confound
and swiftly cut its opponents.
msgstr: Sa tête porte des cornes affûtées comme\ndes lames. Selon la légende, il déroutait et\ntranchait ses ennemis tel un tourbillon.

msgid:
Tornadus expels massive energy from
its tail, causing severe storms.
Its power can blow entire houses away.
It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.
msgstr: Boréas libère une immense énergie par la\nqueue et déclenche des tempêtes qui\nemportent les maisons. Il vole à 300 km/h.

msgid:
An example of what is known as a
“form change”. Tornadus has been
sighted crossing the ocean while in this
form.
msgstr:
Un exemple de ce qu’on appelle un
“changement de forme”. On a vu
Boréas traverser l’océan sous
cette forme.

msgid:
The spikes on its tail discharge immense
bolts of lightning. Countless charred
remains mar the landscape of places
through which Thundurus has passed.
msgstr: Les pointes de sa queue lancent de\nterribles éclairs. Des débris calcinés\njonchent les lieux où Fulguris est passé.

msgid:
It pulverizes foes into nothingness
with showers of devastatingly
powerful lightning bolts launched
from the string of orbs on its tail.
msgstr:
Il réduit ses ennemis à néant sous
une pluie d’éclairs dévastateurs
lancés depuis le chapelet d’orbes
de sa queue.

msgid:
This Pokémon appears in legends. It
sends flames into the air from its tail,
burning up everything around it. It helps
those who want to build a world of truth.
msgstr: Ce Pokémon légendaire crache des flammes\npar la queue et brûle tout alentour. Il aide\nceux qui veulent bâtir un monde de vérité.

msgid:
This legendary Pokémon can scorch the
world with lightning. It has a generator
that creates electricity in its tail. It
assists those with strong ideals.
msgstr:
Ce Pokémon légendaire peut embraser le
monde d’éclairs grâce au générateur de sa
queue. Il aide ceux qui ont de grands
idéaux.

msgid:
The energy that comes pouring from its
tail increases the nutrition in the soil,
granting bountiful crops. It has been
hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”
msgstr: L’énergie qui jaillit de sa queue fertilise\nla terre et donne de belles récoltes. On le\nsurnomme “le Gardien des Champs”.

msgid:
Landorus soars through the sky in
this form, bestowing plentiful
harvests upon the land and earning the
people's reverence.
msgstr:
Sous cette forme, Démétéros parcourt
le ciel en offrant aux terres des
récoltes abondantes, ce qui lui vaut
la vénération des gens.

msgid:
This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a
hero to fill in the missing parts of its
body with truth or ideals. Its body became
frozen when its energy leaked out.
msgstr: Ce Pokémon légendaire attend un héros qui\ncomblera son corps de vérité ou d’idéal. Il\na gelé quand son énergie s’est échappée.

msgid:
When it is resolute, its body fills with
power and it becomes swifter. It crosses
the world, running over the surfaces of
oceans and rivers.
msgstr: Quand il est déterminé, son corps déborde\nd’énergie et il devient plus rapide. Il\nparcourt le monde en courant sur l’eau.

msgid:
The power that lay hidden in its
body now covers its horn, turning it
into a sword that can slice through
anything.
msgstr:
La force cachée dans son corps
recouvre désormais sa corne, qui
devient une épée capable de tout
trancher.

msgid:
The melodies sung by Meloetta have the
power to make Pokémon that hear them
happy or sad. Many famous songs have been
inspired by the tunes that Meloetta plays.
msgstr:
Les mélodies de Meloetta rendent joyeux ou
tristes les Pokémon qui les entendent.
Elles ont inspiré de nombreuses chansons
célèbres.

msgid: Meloetta's melodies are sung with\na special vocalization method that can\ncontrol the feelings of those who hear it.
msgstr: Meloetta chante ses mélodies avec\nune technique vocale qui contrôle\nles émotions de ceux qui l’écoutent.

msgid:
The quills on its head are usually soft.
When it flexes them, the points become
so hard and sharp that they can pierce
rock without any effort.
msgstr: Les piquants de sa tête sont souples.\nQuand il les contracte, ils deviennent si\ndurs qu’ils percent la roche sans effort.

msgid:
They strengthen the sturdy shell covering
their bodies by running into one another.
They are very kind and won't start fights,
but will counterattack with sharp quills.
msgstr:
Ils renforcent leur carapace en se
rentrant dedans. Très gentils, ils ne
cherchent pas la bagarre, mais ripostent
avec leurs piquants.

msgid:
It shields its allies from danger with
its own body. When it takes a defensive
posture with its fists guarding its face,
it can withstand a bomb blast.
msgstr: Il protège ses alliés de son propre corps.\nLorsqu’il se met en garde, poings devant le\nvisage, il résiste même à une bombe.

msgid:
As it walks, it munches on a twig to fill
itself with energy in place of a snack.
It intimidates opponents by puffing hot
air out of its roomy ears.
msgstr: En marchant, il grignote une brindille en\nguise d’en-cas. Il intimide ses ennemis en\nsoufflant de l’air chaud par ses oreilles.

msgid:
Braixen has a twig stuck in its tail.
When the twig is plucked from its tail,
friction sets the twig alight. The flame
is used to send signals to its allies.
msgstr: Il garde une brindille dans sa queue. Quand\nil la retire, la friction l’enflamme. Il s’en\nsert pour faire des signaux à ses alliés.

msgid:
It gazes into the flame at the tip of its
branch to achieve a focused state, which
allows it to see into the future. It uses
psychic power to incinerate its foes.
msgstr: En fixant la flamme au bout de sa branche,\nil entre en transe et lit l’avenir. Il brûle\nses ennemis par la force psychique.

msgid:
It protects its skin by covering its body
in bubbles it secretes from its chest and
back. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it
keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.
msgstr:
Il protège sa peau avec des bulles
sécrétées par son torse et son dos. Sous
son air insouciant, il reste toujours sur
ses gardes.

msgid:
It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with
precise control, hitting empty cans up to
a hundred feet away. Frogadier's swiftness
is unparalleled.
msgstr: Il lance avec précision des cailloux\nenrobés de bulles sur des canettes à\ntrente mètres. Sa rapidité est sans égale.

msgid:
It has ears like shovels. Digging holes
strengthens its ears so much that they
can sever thick roots effortlessly.
Bunnelby dig the whole night through.
msgstr: Ses oreilles sont comme des pelles. A force\nde creuser, elles tranchent sans effort de\ngrosses racines. Il creuse toute la nuit.

msgid:
With its powerful ears it reduces dense
bedrock to rubble. It can be a big help
at construction sites. When it's finished
digging, it lounges about lazily.
msgstr:
Ses puissantes oreilles réduisent la roche
en miettes. Il rend de grands services sur
les chantiers, puis paresse une fois le
travail fini.

msgid:
This amiable Pokémon is easy to train.
But when battle is joined, it shows its
ferocious side. It's merciless to
intruders that enter its territory.
msgstr:
Ce Pokémon aimable est facile à dresser.
Mais au combat, il se montre féroce et
impitoyable envers les intrus sur son
territoire.

msgid:
